name: Snip
author: user
description: Drag a region of the screen straight onto the clipboard, like the Windows snipping tool

barWidget.description: Click, drag a region, and the image is on your clipboard. Right click also saves it to Pictures and offers the editor.

schema.label: Left click also saves a file
schema.description: Off: the snip only goes to the clipboard. On: it is also written to your screenshots folder.
